name: Kokonut UI
summary: Free open-source React/Tailwind/Motion components via @kokonutui shadcn registry (Pro companion excluded).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free registry components of ~51 items in registry.json / 100+ claimed on site; not a full inventory.
Freemium: free OSS at kokonutui.com; Kokonut UI Pro at https://kokonutui.pro (premium components/templates) — Pro excluded; no paid unlock.
Templates listed under kokonutui.pro in llms.txt — excluded from verified free set.
Some comps (liquid-glass-card, particle-button, bento-grid) depend on shadcn/ui Button/Card and/or next/image / next/font — ensure shadcn base + Next where required.
ARCHITECTURE §5 prefers iframe for unusual/tactile motion; all demos are docs iframes.

components.name: Beams Background
components.summary: Canvas background of drifting light beams with configurable intensity.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/beams-background

import BeamsBackground from "@/components/kokonutui/beams-background"

<BeamsBackground intensity="strong" className="min-h-[24rem] rounded-xl" />

copyPrompt.text: Use Kokonut UI free component `Beams Background` (slug `beams-background`) from https://kokonutui.com/docs/backgrounds/beams-background. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/beams-background` after `npx shadcn@latest init` and adding the `@kokonutui` registry (`"@kokonutui": "https://kokonutui.com/r/{name}.json"`) to `components.json` registries (see https://kokonutui.com/docs). Registry item: https://kokonutui.com/r/beams-background.json. Import from `@/components/kokonutui/beams-background` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS; many items need `motion` and/or `lucide-react`. Free & open source MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kokonut-labs/kokonutui/main/LICENSE); Kokonut UI Pro (https://kokonutui.pro) is separate — prefer free-tier only; do not unlock Pro.
